title: 第7章 精英级刺鞭树妖第8章 肉芽草为了第二天赋
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: “不错。”
望着身高顶到自己脖颈的斩夜螳螂，夜玄满意点头。
见天空太阳高悬，阳光透过树叶直刺而下，夜玄不再耽误，取出鼻岛地图继续前行。
地图上标记的三阶魔药血菩提，必须拿到手！
晌午时分，密林中，身披树叶、警惕前行的夜玄停住脚步，目光紧盯不远处一名麻裙少女。
少女面色苍白，就这么安静的躺卧在一棵结满红果的棕色歪脖子树下。
而在她身侧，一具无头螳螂尸骸无力紧挨。
断裂的颈部内，正源源不断流淌绿色虫血。
“哎呀，是野生的小美人儿，在这鼻岛压抑的很，要不要趁机做些什么？”
夜玄脑内，黑姬笑着调侃。
“刺鞭树妖。”
“刺鞭树妖？”
“装，继续给我装。”
夜玄眼皮一翻，捡起枚石块砸向棕色歪脖子树。
石块砸中，歪脖子树无动于衷，风平浪静。
“呵呵。”
夜玄乐了，缓缓激活御兽师天赋死之瞳。
视线变的灰暗，歪脖子树上，浮现出一枚红色小光点。
红色光点于树干内缓慢移动，一会窜到上面，一会窜到下面，像是有多动症一样。
刺鞭树妖，天赋断肢重生，妖兽血脉：精英。
弱点，树干内，会随时移动躲藏的“树之心”
只有击碎树之心，才能彻底终结刺鞭树妖的生命。
刺鞭树妖这种植物妖兽擅长伪装，能通过果实散发出异香，从而吸引动物来此觅食。
当猎物踏入攻击范围的一刻。
蛰伏已久的刺鞭树妖便会骤然发难，其深埋地底的刺鞭，会以雷霆万钧之势绞杀猎物。
总结，这是一只不能动弹的老六。
夜玄眸子微眯，再次捡起一枚石块、丢出！
这一次，石块并未砸中树体。
而是被一根破土而出的刺鞭缠绕，并缓缓放下。
于夜玄注视中，一根根如灵蛇扭动的青色刺鞭探出，随即缠绕那名少女手、腿、脖颈…

"Not bad."
Looking at Zhanye Mantis, who was as tall as his neck, Ye Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
Seeing the sun hanging high in the sky and the sunlight piercing down through the leaves, Ye Xuan no longer delayed, took out the map of Bi Island and continued moving forward.
The third-level magic potion Blood Bodhi marked on the map must be obtained!
…
At noon, in the dense forest, Ye Xuan, who was walking cautiously and covered with leaves, stopped and stared at a girl in a hemp skirt not far away.
The girl's face was pale, and she was lying quietly under a brown crooked-neck tree full of red fruits.
Beside her, the corpse of a headless mantis lay helplessly close.
Inside the broken neck, green insect blood was flowing continuously.
"Oh, it's a wild little beauty. She's very depressed here on Bi Island. Do you want to take advantage of this opportunity to do something?"
In Ye Xuan's mind, Hei Ji laughed and teased.
"The Thornwhip Dryad."
"Spiritwhip Dryad?"
"Pretend, keep pretending for me."
Ye Xuan rolled his eyelids, picked up a stone and threw it at the brown crooked neck tree.
"Crack!"
When rocks hit it, the crooked-necked tree remained indifferent, and the weather was calm.
"Haha."
Ye Xuan was happy and slowly activated the Eye of Death, the beast master's talent.
His vision turned gray, and a small red light spot appeared on the crooked tree.
The red light spots moved slowly inside the tree trunk, sometimes jumping to the top and sometimes moving to the bottom, like ADHD.
Thorny Whip Dryad, gifted in rebirth from severed limbs, monster bloodline: elite.
Weakness: Inside the trunk, the "Heart of the Tree" can move and hide at any time.
Only by crushing the heart of the tree can the life of the Thornwhip Dryad be completely ended.
Plant monsters such as the Spiny Whip Dryad are good at camouflage and can emit a peculiar fragrance through their fruits, thus attracting animals to come here for food.
The moment the prey steps into the attack range.
The thorn whip tree demon that has been dormant for a long time will suddenly attack. Its thorn whip buried deep in the ground will strangle its prey with thunderous force.
In summary, this is a lao Liu who can't move.
Ye Xuan narrowed his eyes slightly, picked up a stone again, and threw it out!
This time, the stone did not hit the tree.
Instead, it was entangled by a thorn whip that broke out of the ground and was slowly put down.
"Buzz!"
As Ye Xuan watched, green thorn whips that twisted like spiritual snakes came out, and then wrapped around the girl's hands, legs, and neck...
